task.title: Design governed bootstrap for accumulated legacy context drift
task.phase: Supervisor Runtime / Source-only Legacy Bootstrap Follow-up

scope.owned_layer: The explicit mutable-incumbent bootstrap capture, byte-bound trusted rendering, and transaction revalidation boundary in scripts/promote_supervisor_runtime.py, with its focused regression coverage.
not_changing: Immutable candidate cleanliness or normal mutable-incumbent cleanliness
Governed launch-source capture, config CAS, promotion lock ordering, candidate/rollback launch, or health acceptance
Supervisor scheduling, worker routing, task state, live config, live process generations, or deployment state
The source-side prevention of command-checkout task-brief generation merged by SUP-RUNTIME-V10-MUTABLE-TRACKED-DRIFT-FOLLOWUP-20260808

incident.reported_context: The governed f5570754 retry aborted before mutation because the legacy mutable incumbent still contained historical supervisor-generated tracked task-brief overwrites.

read_only_observation.original_failure: ValueError: Tracked git tree is dirty

incident.boundary_reason: The rollback runtime is materialized from the mutable incumbent HEAD, while these legacy task-brief worktree bytes are neither governed launch sources nor rollback source bytes. The transaction must nevertheless bind their exact path set and reject every other tracked or staged difference.

decision.entrypoint: Only OSPromotionBackend.prepare calls capture_mutable_incumbent_snapshot with allow_legacy_task_brief_drift=true, and only when the existing --bootstrap-mutable-incumbent transaction mode is active.
decision.allowed_residue: An unstaged diff-files record must be exactly status M for .orchestrator/task-briefs/<lowercase-task-id>.md. The path set is sorted, captured in MutableIncumbentSnapshot, included in transaction evidence, and required to be identical on every mutable-root revalidation.
fail_closed: Default mutable-incumbent capture still rejects every tracked task-brief overwrite.
Staged drift and non-H index flags are rejected before the legacy exception is considered.
Any added, deleted, renamed, malformed, duplicate, non-task-brief, or changed path set is rejected.

acceptance.statement: A normal or non-bootstrap mutable capture rejects a regenerated tracked task brief.
The explicit bootstrap captures only modified legal task-brief paths and rejects both an added path and a byte change to an already-bound path at revalidation.
The explicit bootstrap rejects staged drift, non-task-brief tracked drift, unprovable canonical bytes, and a symlink substituted for a task brief.
No live promotion or runtime mutation occurs in this task.
acceptance.evidence_ref: Task-scoped source/test/evidence diff only; no promotion command was executed.

acceptance.statement: The post-PR-4648 command-root prevention boundary remains active: queue processing references the task brief, while missing briefs are materialized only in the isolated worker worktree.

The canonical task-brief digest renderer extracts captured expected_head into an isolated temporary directory, rendering strictly from byte-bound trusted tracked sources; untracked modules, worktree modifications, and post-capture ref-switches in the mutable root cannot execute code, create import shadows, or alter rendering before or during rendering.

validation.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv-pantheon/bin/python -m pytest -q scripts/test_promote_supervisor_runtime.py -k 'mutable_incumbent_root_rejects_tracked_source_drift or mutable_incumbent_root_rejects_regenerated_tracked_task_brief_in_linked_worktree or mutable_incumbent_bootstrap_binds_only_tracked_task_brief_drift or mutable_incumbent_bootstrap_rejects_staged_task_brief_drift or mutable_incumbent_bootstrap_rejects_noncanonical_task_brief_bytes or mutable_incumbent_bootstrap_rejects_same_path_byte_drift_on_revalidation or mutable_incumbent_bootstrap_rejects_symlinked_task_brief_drift or mutable_incumbent_bootstrap_rejects_non_task_brief_tracked_drift or mutable_incumbent_root_accepts_bound_worktree_gitfile'

required_checks: Confirm the exception is reachable only through explicit mutable bootstrap and not through normal candidate or mutable cleanliness paths.
Confirm only unstaged modified legal task-brief paths are accepted, and their exact set is bound across revalidation and serialized to transaction evidence.
Confirm all source/config/runtime/scheduling surfaces named out of scope remain unchanged.
Confirm no promotion command, live config write, process signal, or runtime deployment was executed.

rollback.source: Revert the reviewed task PR; normal strict cleanliness remains the default and the exception is local to bootstrap capture.
rollback.live: Not applicable; this task makes no live mutation.
